title: microchilus lunifer
intro: Microchilus lunifer, commonly known as Moonlight Orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and its leaves, roots, and flowers are rich in bioactive constituents, which provide numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Microchilus lunifer include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
